C0513.title: Android Reverse Engineering – Packet Capture Analysis and Tooling Overview
C0513.summary: During the reverse engineering of an Android application, the developer captured login request packets and identified encrypted username and password fields. By analyzing the encryption algorithm, the credentials were successfully decrypted and used to simulate a login. Packet capture helps locate critical sections within encrypted or obfuscated code, providing leads for further reverse engineerin
